text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said Thursday it upgraded Telecom Argentina to hold from sell based on:
-- DMG's revision Thursday of Argentine 1997 GDP estimates to 4.9 percent from 4.0 percent and 1998 estimates to 4.3 percent from 4.0 percent.
-- Telecom's return to moderate real earnings growth of nine percent in its fiscal years 97 and 98 after declining 18 percent in 96.
-- However, pending regulatory issues, higher competition and lower prices may hurt profits in the next 12 months.
-- DMG expects Telecom to remain a market performer in the 12 months and said it is trading at a high premium to Telebras and Telefonica del Peru.
